name: Raúl Párraga
detail: Chair announced the committee outcome; his own position was not established. The Chamber describes a failure to reach consensus.

name: Rodrigo Paz
detail: President; announced the repeal of the IGF in November 2025.

name: Comisión de Planificación, Política Económica y Finanzas (Cámara de Diputados)
detail: Removed A0002: Chamber account says no consensus to approve repeal, insufficient to establish a committee position supporting the tax.

name: Edmand Lara
detail: Explicitly supported repealing IGF in November 2025; later criticised the announced repeal as favouring the wealthy, without a clear position on retaining it. Recheck any later unambiguous statement.
